examples.question: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of size n?
Explain in one sentence why cross-validation is used in machine learning.
examples.reference_answer: Cross-validation estimates how well a model generalizes to unseen data by training and evaluating it across multiple different train/validation splits.

examples.question: What does the acronym RAG stand for in the context of large language models?
If a model achieves 92% accuracy on a dataset where 90% of labels belong to one class, is accuracy alone a reliable metric? Explain briefly.
examples.reference_answer: No. A model that always predicts the majority class would already reach 90% accuracy, so 92% may reflect little real skill; per-class precision, recall, or F1 should be used instead.

examples.question: What HTTP status code should a REST API return when a resource is successfully created?
What is the primary difference between p50 and p95 latency?
examples.reference_answer: p50 (median) latency is the value below which half of requests fall, representing typical performance. p95 latency is the value below which 95% of requests fall, capturing near-worst-case performance and revealing tail-latency issues the median hides.
